words.gloss: closing of the eyes in sleep

literal: Inside fire sleeping even is possible; in poverty any one closing of eyes is difficult.
translation: It is possible even to sleep while enveloped in fire; but in the midst of poverty, it is impossible to get even a wink of sleep.
modern: நெருப்புக்குள் படுத்துத் தூங்குவதும் கூடச் சாத்தியமாகும்; ஆனால் வறுமையின் துன்பத்தில் வாழும்போது சிறிதும் கண்மூடித் தூங்குவது என்பது முடியாததாகும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts physical torment with the mental agony of destitution. The poet states that one might somehow manage to fall asleep even when surrounded by burning fire, but it is absolutely impossible to find any sleep when trapped in extreme poverty. The word 'நிரப்பு' specifically denotes poverty or emptiness, and 'கண்பாடு' refers to the closing of eyes to sleep. Through this extreme comparison, the verse highlights how the constant worry and anxiety of poverty are far more sleepless and agonizing than physical heat.
